title: Sigmund configuration (sigmund.yaml)
description: Signers, the trust policy (rules and defaults), and how signing and verification run. Sigmund is authoritative: this schema states keys and value shapes for editors, while signer references, rule ties and issuer assertability are checked when Sigmund loads the file. See https://github.com/cyberstamp/sigmund/blob/main/docs/configuration.md

issuers.description: Issuers trusted to vouch for identities in signer entries that name none: keys.openpgp.org, or the https:// URL of an OIDC issuer.

signers.description: The identity registry: signer ids mapped to the credentials that prove them. Rules and signing.signer refer to signers by id.

artifact-sets.description: Named lists of artifact patterns, used by name in a rule's match.

rules.description: The trust policy. Declaring rules, an empty list included, turns enforcement on: an artifact no rule matches is NOT_CONFIGURED and fails.

defaults.description: Enforcement and extra-claims defaults for every rule. Only valid together with rules.

signing.description: Which identity to sign as and which tools sign.

signer.description: The id of the signer, from signers, to sign as.

toolchain.description: The tools that sign, in priority order. Only the listed tools are used.

credential-types.description: The credential types to produce by default.

profiles.description: Named sets of credential types, chosen by name, for example --profile classic.

verification.description: How verification runs. These settings change what Sigmund can see, never what it accepts.

toolchain.description: The tools that verify, in priority order. When set, only these are used.

resolve-signers.description: Fetch missing keys from keyservers, and ask directories in issuers for the verified addresses of keys. Default true.

import-to-keyring.description: Persist fetched keys in the tool's keyring instead of keeping them for the session only. Default false.

keyservers.description: Keyserver URLs to fetch missing keys from, asked in order. Default hkps://keys.openpgp.org.

tools.description: Per-tool settings, used by signing and verification.

gnupg-home.description: GnuPG home directory to read public keys from. Default ~/.gnupg.

cert-d-home.description: Shared OpenPGP cert-d directory for public certificates. Default ~/.local/share/pgp.cert.d.

bc-private-home.description: Directory of BC's private key store. Default ~/.local/share/sigmund/bc-private.

signing-fingerprint.description: Full fingerprint of the key to sign with, or a list of them to sign with each; a key's type comes from its fingerprint's length. Ignored when a key comes from signing-key-env or tsk-file.

tsk-file.description: Path to an exported Transferable Secret Key to sign with.

signing-key-env.description: Environment variable holding an ASCII-armored signing key. Default SIGMUND_BC_SIGNING_KEY.

passphrase-env.description: Environment variable holding the key's passphrase. Default SIGMUND_BC_PASSPHRASE.

cipher-suite.description: Algorithm sigmund keygen generates when --cipher-suite is not given. Default ed25519.

sq.description: Sequoia, run as the sq command.

executable.description: Path to the sq executable. Default sq.

signing-fingerprint.description: Full fingerprint of the key to sign with, or a list of them to sign with each; a key's type comes from its fingerprint's length. Default: sq's sign.signer-self.

gpg.description: GnuPG, run as the gpg command.

executable.description: Path to the gpg executable. Default gpg.

signing-fingerprint.description: Full v4 fingerprint of the key to sign with, or a list of them to sign with each. Default: default-key in gpg.conf, else the first secret key.

passphrase-env.description: Environment variable holding the key's passphrase. Default SIGMUND_GPG_PASSPHRASE.

sigstore.description: Sigstore keyless signing; available when sigmund-sigstore is on the classpath.

staging.description: Use the Sigstore staging instance. For testing only. Default false.

trusted-root.description: Path to a custom trusted_root.json. Default: fetched via TUF from the public-good instance.

interactive.description: Allow interactive OIDC browser login. Default false.

stringOrList.description: One value, or a list of them.

signingFingerprint.description: A full OpenPGP fingerprint: 40 hexadecimal characters for a v4 key, 64 for v6. A key ID, an address or a user ID is not accepted.

signingFingerprintV4.description: A full OpenPGP v4 fingerprint: 40 hexadecimal characters. A key ID, an address or a user ID is not accepted.

signingFingerprints.description: A full OpenPGP fingerprint, or a non-empty list of distinct ones. Sigmund also rejects the same fingerprint listed twice in different case.

signingFingerprintsV4.description: A full OpenPGP v4 fingerprint, or a non-empty list of distinct ones. Sigmund also rejects the same fingerprint listed twice in different case.

pgp4.description: A full OpenPGP v4 fingerprint: 40 hexadecimal characters. A key ID is not accepted.

pgp6.description: A full OpenPGP v6 fingerprint: 64 hexadecimal characters.

credentials.description: The credentials a signer or member may carry.

pgp4.description: OpenPGP v4 fingerprint, or a list of them — a signer that rotated keys keeps every key it signed with.

pgp6.description: OpenPGP v6 fingerprint, or a list of them.

email.description: An address, accepted only as vouched for by a listed issuer. A user ID on a key is never matched on its own.

identities.description: Complete identities: an optional issuer and the attributes it must have attested.

anyOf.description: An email address, vouched for by a listed issuer.

members.description: The keys of an organization's members, each carrying its own credentials.

identity.description: An identity an issuer attests. Only the attributes named need to match; at least one besides issuer is required.

issuer.description: The issuer that must attest this identity: keys.openpgp.org or an OIDC issuer URL. Default: the listed issuers.

subject.description: The certificate subject; carries the git ref, so it changes with every release.

build-config-uri.description: The build configuration, for example the workflow file.

anyOf.description: A signer id that must sign.

any-of.description: Signer ids, any one of which satisfies this clause.

match.description: Artifact patterns (group, group:artifact, group:artifact:version) or artifact-set names. A one-word group is written group:*.

requires.description: A signer id, or a list of clauses that must all be satisfied: each a signer id or {any-of: [...]}. Without requires, a rule accepts nothing and tolerates through on-* overrides.

enforcement.description: What an outcome does: fail blocks, warn reports, ignore tolerates. FAILED always fails and cannot be overridden.

extraClaims.description: Verified claims beyond those requires accepted: reject (default) makes the artifact UNSATISFIED, ignore accepts it on the claims it needed.
